meta.title: The BOQ report is offered only for BOQ events
gaps: Identify and assert the BOQ-specific report option: "BOQ Report" is explicitly not a rendered label, and no known replacement or domain assertion exists.
Identify the report's format selector and assert that it is disabled; no known label or domain assertion exists.
Target both the existing BOQ event and ordinary event reliably: their titles or IDs were not supplied.
Enable or verify the boq_in_erfx_allowed tenant gate; no catalog step manages or reads this setting.
